title: Each occurrence of a repeating event carries its date in the page title, and event meta descriptions read as one line

source.ref: Live scan of frequencylocal.com 2026-10-14: 24 sitemap pages titled "Circle Night · Frequency", 14 "New moon", 11 "The Coaches Club" and more, and descriptions carrying the host's raw line breaks.

detail: generateMetadata titled every occurrence with the bare event name, so a series' indexed occurrences competed as duplicate titles, and passed the host's description through with its newlines. A non-anchor occurrence now reads "<name> · <short date>" (formatEventDate, UTC like every event date); the series anchor keeps the bare name because its stored start is the first meeting. The description collapses whitespace before the 155-character snippet cut.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/(public)/events/[slug]/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!s.includes('facts.isAnchor ? event.title :')||!s.includes('formatEventDate(event.starts_at)'))bad.push('occurrences of a repeating event still share one title');if(!/replace\(\/\\\\s\+\/g, ' '\)/.test(s))bad.push('event descriptions keep raw line breaks');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-870: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
